rimcli.tests.e01m001 module

rimcli.tests.e01m001.test(file)[source]

Test the rim-cli command line interface. This test runs the rim-cli command line interface on a single im7 image file. The input file is B00001.im7, which is a DIC image file. :param file: The path to the im7 image file to be tested. :type file: str

Return type:

None

Example

test(‘/path/to/image.im7’)
